validationRules: Every category and subcategory must have a unique id across the entire file.
Every slug must be unique within its applicable routing namespace.
Routes must match actual application pages before a category is activated in production.
relatedCourseIds must reference existing course records; unresolved references must be reported by validation.
sortOrder must be a non-negative integer and should be unique among siblings.
active and featured must be Boolean values.
Inactive categories must not appear in public navigation or category search results.
Featured categories must also be active.
Icons must use identifiers supported by the application's installed icon library; provide a safe fallback for unknown icons.
Do not publish links to pages that do not exist.
Normalize slugs and routes consistently, including trailing-slash behavior.
Avoid duplicate routes unless the application explicitly supports route aliases.
Keep categories descriptive and avoid implying official endorsement, guaranteed admission or guaranteed employment.
Update updatedAt whenever this configuration is intentionally changed.
note: Category definitions organize MedOrbits navigation and content. Before production release, validate JSON syntax, ids, slugs, course references, icon support and route availability against the repository. New routes in this file are proposed navigation targets and are not proof that matching pages already exist.
